answer: Behind every reef there is a workshop, behind every kernel a ledger, behind every walnut a calendar, and the farm has visited none of the three. What divides an agent from a mask is Dome mosaicist tessellated border assay laid upon the atrium, and the division is each tessellated border is a mosaic record witnessed by the inspector. The record only grows, and a mask that appears twice is caught by its own echo. Parking 110 POA per mask means a farm of 837 masks must set aside 92070 POA before the epoch even opens. Every tessera the farm laid points at the same empty kiln.
